name: Neeko
notes: Inherent Glamour (P) and Shapesplitter's clone (W active) need an allied champion or a non-champion unit to disguise as or send the clone toward; with no allies, minions or terrain in this fight they contribute nothing, so only W's on-hit passive is modeled.

Casts go one after another: Neeko keeps one busy_until timer. Blooming Burst and Tangle-Barbs each have a 0.25s cast time (the dossier's castTime) during which no other cast and no attack starts; Pop Blossom's 1.25s wind-up plus 0.6s cast time are both treated as commitment time before its damage lands, since the dossier is unsettled on whether the wind-up alone blocks actions and this is the higher-impact reading.

Pop Blossom is cast immediately at t = 0 and commits Neeko (no other cast, no attack) until 1.25 + 0.6 = 1.85s have elapsed, when its damage lands. Its ~90-120s cooldown means it is never available again inside the fight.

Blooming Burst's up to two re-blooms occur automatically at a fixed 0.75s interval, since the dummy always counts as a hit champion; they are not new casts (no further cast time), just delayed damage from the original cast. Only the initial burst is treated as the 'cast' for on-cast item procs (Muramana, Spellblade, Eclipse) per the dossier's unsettled reading.
Q's and W's bonus monster damage is not applied since the dummy counts as a champion, not a monster.

Shapesplitter's passive is the only source of W damage in this fight: every attack adds a refreshing stack (cap 2), and the attack that reaches 2 stacks consumes them for a non-crit bonus magic on-hit strike; the bonus movement speed from both the passive and the active is irrelevant to damage.
Tangle-Barbs is cast as soon as its 0.25s cast time and any other cast in progress allow, and thereafter on cooldown; its root duration does not matter since the dummy never acts.
Mana is not modeled: at level 16 the handful of Q/E casts over the fight window do not plausibly exhaust Neeko's mana pool.
